newsitem.title: CANADA: WIC stock up on block trade, no news seen.
newsitem.headline: WIC stock up on block trade, no news seen.

text.p: Shares in WIC Western International Communications Ltd jumped on Tuesday with most of the activity in one block trade, although analysts said they knew of no news to account for the rise.
WIC class B shares were up 1.75 at 22. Volume totalled 16,740 shares, including 13,500 in a block crossed by CIBC Wood Gundy.
The broacaster's stock has gained recently after its CellularVision unit won a license to provide LMCS wireless communications. WIC has said it may sell a stake in CellularVision.

The Financial Post newspaper said today that WIC confirmed it was in talks with communications giant BCE Inc on selling a minority stake. Traders said WIC had floated the idea before, but a WIC spokeswoman had no immediate comment.

One analyst said he doubted that accounted for the gain in WIC shares. "That has been around before...It seems quite unlikely," he said. Another analyst said he knew of no developments to account for the gain in WIC's share price and noted that investors were disappointed by the company's fiscal fourth-quarter results released last week.
